introduction: This is my application for the developer position within your company.
Passionate about application development and programming for nearly 10 years, I recently decided to dedicate myself to this career.
I bring almost ten years of amateur video game development and creative tool development, in addition to my college training in application development.
On this site, you will find links to my completed projects, as well as more information about my background, my completed projects, and my training.
If you received a link to this site, it is because I am motivated to contribute to ambitious projects like yours, and to grow within your team.
Perhaps you will also find useful my years of experience teaching French as a second language, from which I draw a mastery of developing structured lessons and fruitful leadership.
Thanking you for your consideration and wishing you a wonderful day,

achievements.title: Internship
feats: Rapid assimilation of server and client code
Deployment of a transactional website to production
achievements.description: For my end-of-study internship (culminating in 2025), the community organization Le Filon recruited me to complete Banque-à-pitons, a transactional website that had been in development for 7 years. I thus finalized their website and successfully ensured its deployment to production.

achievements.title: Studies
achievements.description: This training allowed me to discover certain aspects of application development that I was unaware of, such as databases and version control systems. Beyond the coursework, I also led some classes for the introductory programming course and acted as a tutor for peers facing difficulties.

achievements.title: Mico Wata
feats: Live coding on Twitch and Youtube
Live programming of interactive music and textures
achievements.description: This creator name marks a period of public creation, initially musical, on a modular synthesizer, then audio-visual with the help of the web application Hydra, a fragment shader editor, and various methods of communication between audio and video. The goal was to produce abstract works where sound and image are inseparable.

achievements.title: Zoo's Mad
achievements.description: My first programming project. A roguelike deckbuilding collectible card game. The card collection is entirely generated by a minimal algorithm. The game contains no images. The graphics are entirely drawn on canvas.
